title: Kamsarmax Rebounds, Soybeans Set Records
summary:
Main
Image reference: unsplash-image-_pBBkarmFTs.jpg | assets/2026-11-17_kamsarmax-rebounds-soybeans-set-records_img_unsplash-image-pbbkarmfts_efbdc77b5088.jpg
By Eirini Diamantara & Dimitris Roumeliotis
The dry bulk market continues to demonstrate contrasting dynamics across the Kamsarmax and Ultramax segments, although the considerable earnings differential observed in late October has narrowed during the first half of November. According to Baltic Exchange data, average Kamsarmax earnings (P5TC) increased by 5.7% week-on-week, reaching USD 19,063/day on 13 November, compared with USD 16,999/day at the end of October. Meanwhile, Ultramax earnings (S11TC) stood at USD 23,203/day, recording a more modest weekly increase of 1.1%.
